blocks.text: Sooraj ki tawanai ko behtar tareeqe se jazb aur istemal karne ke liye photosynthetic pigments guchhon (clusters) mein munazzam hote hain jinhein photosystems kehte hain. Yeh photosystems chloroplast ki thylakoid membranes mein dhanse hote hain.

blocks.alt: Kata hua chloroplast jis ka jism (body) peeche upar baen (left) taraf jata hai. Kate hue rukh par outer membrane, inner membrane (jamni patti) aur andar stroma nazar aata hai; stroma mein thali jaisi thylakoids ke paanch dher (grana) sabz lamellae se jure hain. blocks.text: Har chapti thali thylakoid hai; thylakoids ka dher granum (jama grana) kehlata hai. Grana ko jorne wali patli jhilliyan lamellae hain. Thylakoid membranes mein pigments aur photosystems hote hain (light-dependent reactions), aur in ke gird ka maadda stroma hai (Calvin cycle).

Photosystems mein photosynthetic pigments aur electron transport chain ke carriers hote hain. Har photosystem ke do hisse hain: roshni jama karne wala ‘antenna complex’ aur ‘reaction centre’ (Fig 5.7). Antenna complex ke bohat se pigment molecules roshni pakarte hain aur yeh tawanai reaction centre tak pohanchate hain (kitab ise high-energy electrons ki shakal kehti hai). Reaction centre mein chlorophyll-a ke ek ya zyada molecules hote hain jo high-energy electrons ko primary electron acceptor ko dete hain. Yeh acceptor unhein electron carriers ke silsile ko deta hai, jise electron transport chain kehte hain.

Chloroplast mein do photosystems hain: photosystem-I (PS-I) aur photosystem-II (PS-II); in ke naam daryaft ki tarteeb se rakhe gaye. PS-I ke reaction centre mein P700 chlorophyll-a hota hai jo 700 nm ki roshni sab se zyada jazb karta hai. PS-II ke reaction centre mein P680 chlorophyll-a hota hai jo 680 nm ki roshni sab se behtar jazb karta hai.
